annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Communication from the Commission ... Building trust in human-centric artificial intelligence' (COM(2019) 168 final)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Communication from the Commission ... Building trust in human-centric artificial intelligence' (COM(2019) 168 final)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Economic and Social Committee (Rapporteur: Madinier)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 47
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on the Commission's 2019 communication on trustworthy human-centric AI. It supports human oversight, explainability and certification, and calls for clear liability rules, insurability, updated product liability and GDPR review, worker consultation, safety standards for human-machine collaboration (cobots), and international AI standards.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for clear rules assigning responsibility to natural or legal persons and examining insurability of AI systems
Calls for robust certification and a European trusted-AI Business Certificate
Standards needed so human-machine collaboration does not harm workers; emergency brake principle; cites ISO/TS 15066
Adapt product liability rules for AI and digital products; review GDPR regularly
Seeks international agreement on trustworthy AI via G7/G20 and prevention of malicious and dual use of AI
